historical_exposure: 2022H2 and 2023 outcomes were previously viewed for other experiments; this is new-family retrospective discovery, not untouched OOS.
hypothesis: A standard 14-session stochastic %K crossing above its 3-session %D after %K was at or below 20 on the prior official session, with a signal-day close in the upper half of its range, marks a short-term oversold turn.

candidate_pool.universe: Frozen daily XTKS OHLCV panel; each row must have internally valid positive-volume OHLCV.
candidate_pool.stochastic_k: 100 * (close - lowest low over the current and preceding 13 official XTKS sessions) / (highest high over those same 14 sessions - lowest low); flat denominators are missing.
candidate_pool.stochastic_d: Simple mean of the current and two preceding session %K values.
candidate_pool.signal: Prior %K <= prior %D and prior %K <= 20; current %K > current %D; current close location >= 0.50.
candidate_pool.complete_history: All 14 official sessions and all three %K observations must be present; missing sessions are never bridged.

score_and_selection.selection: Independent Top5 per official XTKS session; at most five names and abstain when the pool is empty.
score_and_selection.cooldown: A selected symbol is ineligible for selection on the immediately following official XTKS session; unselected candidates do not update cooldown.

target: Signal-date close-known setup; enter next official XTKS session open and exit fifth official XTKS session close including entry; canonical label return is exit close / entry open - 1.
target_actionability: Use the frozen canonical target builder unchanged: every subsequent XTKS session through exit must have valid positive OHLCV, positive volume, and an open/previous-close ratio in [0.60, 1.40]. Missing/invalid/gap-flagged labels remain unresolved; no backfill or substitution.

discovery_gates_each_period.net_mean_median_and_top3_excluded_mean: all strictly positive at 0.5% assumed round-trip cost and win rate > 0.50
discovery_gates_each_period.minus10_and_minus20_rates: no higher than the all-candidate pool on the same signal dates
discovery_gates_each_period.positive_months: at least half of resolved months
discovery_gates_each_period.complete_daily_cohorts: at least 20 complete dates; cohort net mean, median, and top3-excluded mean strictly positive
discovery_gates_each_period.decision: Both periods must pass every gate; otherwise reject without threshold or ranking replacement.
